thread.title: Apple buys maker of augmented-reality lenses: report

author: morningstar.com
title: Apple buys maker of augmented-reality lenses: report
text:
Apple Inc. (AAPL) confirmed it has acquired a small Colorado company that makes lenses for augmented-reality glasses, Reuters reported (https://www.reuters.com/article/us-apple-tech/apple-buys-startup-focused-on-lenses-for-ar-glasses-idUSKCN1LE2VS?il=0) late Wednesday. Besides making displays, Akonia Holographics also holds more than 200 patents related to holographic technology, Reuters said. The company has raised about $11.6 million in funding, according to Crunchbase (https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/akonia-holographics#section-overview). Last year, Bloomberg News reported (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/apple-could-release-augmented-reality-headset-in-2020-report-2017-11-08) Apple could release an augmented-reality headset in 2020, and in June, the iPhone-maker announced new AR capabilities (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/apple-announces-new-augmented-reality-capabilities-for-ios-12-2018-06-04) for its next mobile operating system, iOS 12. After closing up 1.5% Wednesday, Apple shares edged up 0.4% in after-hours trading.
-Mike Murphy; 2158ET
